name: JetBrains Air Teams
desc: Team layer of JetBrains Air for sharing agent workflows and automating repeatable work.
desc_zh: JetBrains Air 的团队层，用于共享智能体工作流和自动化重复工作。
solves: Each engineer builds their own agent setup and nobody else can reuse it; workflows, intents and verification results are shared across the team.
solves_zh: 每个工程师各自搭一套智能体环境，别人无法复用；工作流、意图和验证结果在团队内共享。
best_for: The same review-and-release routine is rebuilt by hand by every person on the team.
best_for_zh: 同一套审查发布流程，团队里每个人都要各自手工搭一遍。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — blog.jetbrains.com/air RSS feed）。 Launched six days after the wider JetBrains Air product system. The vendor says Air arrives through rolling releases, so the 2026-09-28 date is the first dated first-party post found for this surface; an earlier system-level announcement on 2026-09-22 is reported by media but no first-party page for it was retrieved. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方叫 Air Teams；卡片上带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.jetbrains.com/air/feed/
